name: Konstantin
source: Konstantin, commonly referred to as Lucius' beast, is a high enforcer. He is fiercely loyal to the crown and is only assigned particular tasks that match his unique skillset. Many other species regard him as something of a bogeyman, much to the amusement of his daughter, Tasha.
